headline_of_the_week: 20 women-founded companies raised 1.99B USD in one week per WINS List Issue 20, led by Julia DeWahl closing 470M USD Series C for Antares nuclear microreactors, while Highland Europe closed 1.1B EUR Fund VI, Team8 closed 365M USD Fund III with new Managing Partner Sarit Firon, and Forbes reconfirmed just 1.1 percent of 2025 US VC dollars went to all-women teams.

headlines.title: WINS List Issue 20: 20 women-founded companies raise 1.99B USD in one week
headlines.summary: Amie Sheridan's WINS List Issue 20 aggregates 20 female-founded rounds totaling 1.99B USD in a single week, the strongest weekly female-founded funding signal of 2026.

headlines.title: Antares closes 470M USD Series C led by CEO Julia DeWahl for nuclear microreactors
headlines.summary: Antares raised 470M USD Series C, the largest woman-CEO deep-tech round of 2026. Julia DeWahl leads Antares' nuclear microreactor thesis.

headlines.title: Forbes: former PayPal exec Nathalie Molina Nino is fixing VC blind spot with AQi 10M USD equity crowdfunding
headlines.summary: Forbes profile of AQi CEO Nathalie Molina Nino details a 10M USD equity crowdfunding round to fix venture capital blind spots from the top of the founder funnel. Cites 1.1 percent of 2025 US VC dollars to all-women teams (down from 2.1 percent in 2019) and BCG return data.

headlines.title: Highland Europe closes 1.1B EUR Fund VI with Irena Goldenberg on growth team
headlines.summary: Highland Europe closes Fund VI at 1.1B EUR, targeting late Series A and B European software. Growth partner Irena Goldenberg is a direct fit for Pink X's late-stage female-founded software pipeline.

headlines.title: Team8 closes 365M USD Fund III, names Sarit Firon Managing Partner
headlines.summary: Israeli venture studio Team8 closed 365M USD Fund III to back AI-native enterprise companies and promoted Sarit Firon to Managing Partner.
